messages:
zoe: noticed p95 on host decode up ~9% after kernel-selector canary. Mostly for tiny streaming reqs (<200 tokens).

min: can you attach a perf summary?

bench-bot: summary: p95 +9% vs baseline. Hot stacks: host::parse_loop (40%), tokenizer::utf8_check (22%), http2::writev_small(13%). Report: https://perf/reports/7965439999

diego: seems kernel selector led to earlier lane assignment -> smaller batches. More syscalls and kv churn. KV missrate +2.8% on canary.

zoe: hypothesis: batch assembly window cut too short for bursty tiny reqs. Also io fragmentation.

min: quick test - bump batch_assembly_ms 6->14 on 5% canary and re-run.

bench-bot: rerun: p95 trimmed by ~5%, cost +2%. http2 small writes down 60%. Link: https://perf/reports/7965439999/retry1

diego: good. alternative: coalesce small writes in host-proxy (io.coalesce=true) to avoid increasing assembly window.

zoe: action: staged rollout
- stage1: batch_window=14 on 5% (min)
- stage2: enable io.coalesce on same canary (diego)
- stage3: tokenizer ascii fastpath (zoe) + kv prefetch tweak (diego)
rollback if p95 > baseline +10% or kv_miss > baseline +5%.

min: i'll add dashboards and a short-term trace for write patterns.

diego: PR for kv prefetch tuning in flight.

zoe: thanks team, post perf links and any regression signals here.
